"import math

import cadquery as cq

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# L-bracket with inner fillet and leg holes - all dimensions in mm (hard-coded)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
LEG_X = 100.0        # horizontal leg length along +X (x: 0 -> 100)
LEG_T = 12.0         # leg thickness (horizontal leg z: 0 -> 12, vertical leg x: 0 -> 12)
LEG_Z = 70.0         # vertical leg height along +Z (z: 0 -> 70)
WIDTH = 50.0         # shared width along +Y (y: 0 -> 50)
FILLET_R = 10.0      # inner concave fillet radius
HOLE_D = 10.0        # through-hole diameter
HOLE_R = HOLE_D / 2.0

HOLE_H_X = 56.0      # horizontal-leg hole center x (axis parallel to Z)
HOLE_C_Y = 25.0      # both holes centered at mid-width y
HOLE_V_Z = 41.0      # vertical-leg hole center z (axis parallel to X)

OVERSHOOT = 5.0      # drill overshoot beyond the faces being pierced

# Inner fillet: arc of radius FILLET_R centered at (T+R, T+R), tangent to the
# top face of the horizontal leg (z = T) at (T+R, T) and to the inner face of
# the vertical leg (x = T) at (T, T+R).
tan_x = LEG_T + FILLET_R                       # 22
tan_z = LEG_T + FILLET_R                       # 22
s = FILLET_R / math.sqrt(2.0)
arc_mid = (tan_x - s, tan_z - s)               # midpoint of the quarter arc

# L-shaped profile drawn in the XZ plane (local u -> global x, local v -> global z).
# The "XZ" plane normal points along -Y, so place the plane at y = WIDTH and
# extrude a positive distance along the normal to land at y in [0, WIDTH].
bracket = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ", origin=(0.0, WIDTH, 0.0))
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(LEG_X, 0.0)                        # bottom of horizontal leg (z = 0)
    .lineTo(LEG_X, LEG_T)                      # outer end of horizontal leg (x = 100)
    .lineTo(tan_x, LEG_T)                      # top of horizontal leg up to tangency
    .threePointArc(arc_mid, (LEG_T, tan_z))    # inner concave fillet, R = 10
    .lineTo(LEG_T, LEG_Z)                      # inner face of vertical leg (x = 12)
    .lineTo(0.0, LEG_Z)                        # top of vertical leg (z = 70)
    .close()                                   # outer face of vertical leg (x = 0)
    .extrude(WIDTH)                            # full width along +Y (y: 0 -> 50)
)

# Through hole in the horizontal leg: axis parallel to Z through (x=56, y=25).
hole_h = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(HOLE_H_X, HOLE_C_Y, -OVERSHOOT))
    .circle(HOLE_R)
    .extrude(LEG_T + 2.0 * OVERSHOOT)          # z: -5 -> 17 (through z = 0..12)
)

# Through hole in the vertical leg: axis parallel to X through (y=25, z=41).
hole_v = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ", origin=(-OVERSHOOT, HOLE_C_Y, HOLE_V_Z))
    .circle(HOLE_R)
    .extrude(LEG_T + 2.0 * OVERSHOOT)          # x: -5 -> 17 (through x = 0..12)
)

bracket = bracket.cut(hole_h).cut(hole_v)

solid = bracket.val()
if not solid.isValid():
    raise RuntimeError("Resulting shape is not a valid B-Rep solid")

cq.exporters.export(bracket, "part.step")

bb = solid.BoundingBox()
print("exported part.step")
print("  volume (mm^3): {:.6f}".format(solid.Volume()))
print("  bbox lengths : {:.6f} x {:.6f} x {:.6f}".format(bb.xlen, bb.ylen, bb.zlen))
print("  face count   : {}".format(len(solid.Faces())))"
